ability.name: Beacon of Azyr
ability.effect:
The next time this turn that the target uses a **^^Prayer^^** or **^^Spell^^** ability, instead of making a casting roll or chanting roll for them, you can use a value of 7 for the roll that cannot be modified. After that ability is resolved, if the target has any ritual points, reset their ritual points total to 0.
**Designer’s Note:** *Ritual points apply modifiers so cannot be used with this ability to increase the chanting roll to more than 7.*
ability.declare: Pick a visible friendly **^^Stormcast Eternals Wizard^^** or **^^Priest^^** wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

ability.name: Sigil of Morrda
ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, that command or **^^Rampage^^** ability has no effect, it still counts as having been used and any command points spent to use that ability are still lost.

ability.name: Banner of Sigmar
ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, your opponent cannot control the target objective while they have no units contesting it.
ability.declare: Pick an objective within 18" of this unit to be the target.
